items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: You were with that band? Yeah. See me on the picture? I see ya.

ctx.x: And Oscar Ruzon is taking a solo.

This boy is the bass player. He just played piano until Charlie Hampton come. Charlie Hampton was playing piano with Raymond Anker at that time. See the bass back in the back? That boy plays piano too. Oh what's his name? You know? I don't know. I'd look in that book. I'd look in my book to get his name. Yeah. He's a youngster.
Oscar Ruzon the uh. He was the leader.
